data.title: Mexican Musician and Family Killed Over Bitcoin Cold Wallet Believed to Hold Millions
data.description: Mexican prosecutors allege suspects targeted Camilo Séptimo keyboardist Jonathan Meléndez and his family while searching for a cold wallet they believed contained millions in Bitcoin.
data.keywords: Ana Paula Barragán, Bitcoin, Diego Sebastián, Meléndez, Jonathan Meléndez, cold wallet
